issues.detail: The Hebrew lists 'Mêsulam, Malúc, A-đai-ah, Gia-sub, Sê-ál và Ra-mốt' but the Hebrew text has 'Mêsulam, Malúc, A-đai-ah, Gia-sub, Sê-ál và Ra-mốt' — actually the Hebrew has 'Mêsulam, Malúc, A-đai-ah, Gia-sub, Sê-ál và Ra-mốt' — wait, the Hebrew is 'מְשֻׁלָּ֤ם מַלּוּךְ֙ וַעֲדָיָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב וּשְׁאָ֥ל ירמות' which lists: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth. The Vietnamese has 'Mêsulam, Malúc, A-đai-ah, Gia-sub, Sê-ál và Ra-mốt' — 'Ra-mốt' is not 'Jeremoth' (ירמות) but a different name. The Hebrew 'ירמות' is 'Jeremoth' (or 'Jerimoth'), not 'Ra-mốt'. This is a name swap/omission of the correct name.
